scope: Loopback setup preview over an isolated copy of prepared onboarding sources

browser.execution: Headless Lune with a disposable profile and the mock setup bridge

checks: Use Defaults and the full custom setup path reach simulated completion.
Changing the search engine retains one selected engine. Privacy and Services choices can be edited and confirmed.
Disabled services show the one-time download notice. The extension failure fixture displays a download error.
Import shows populated, empty and retryable discovery results. The failed import fixture emits the failure response after selection.
Styles and components update within the existing document. Artwork and string edits reload at the selected step, including after real user input.
Light and dark wallpaper load with reduced motion emulated.
Node syntax and Git whitespace checks pass. The repository suite reports 107 passes and one skip.
native_scope: The preview exercises browser-rendered frontend behavior. The packaged WebUI remains the entry point for native integration checks.
